en: The Kingdom of Janggala as one of the two Javanese kingdoms formed when Airlangga abdicated in favour of his two sons in 1045
Its counterpart Kediri as the other kingdom created by the same division
zh: 戎牙路是1045年爱尔朗加让位于两子后形成的爪哇两个王国之一

politics.zh: 戎牙路是1045年爱尔朗加让位于两子后形成的爪哇两个王国之一，另一个是谏义里王国，两者同出东爪哇的卡胡里潘王统。戎牙路的都城在布兰塔斯河三角洲一带的港口区域，控制东爪哇的对外贸易与稻米产区；其历史记载稀少，约在12世纪初被谏义里合并，此后东爪哇由谏义里与后来的辛加沙里、满者伯夷相继统治。
politics.en: The Kingdom of Janggala was one of the two Javanese kingdoms formed when Airlangga abdicated his throne in favour of his two sons in 1045, the other being the Kingdom of Kediri, and both descended from the Kahuripan line of eastern Java. Its capital lay in the harbour area of the Brantas river delta and it controlled the foreign trade and rice lands of eastern Java; the written record for it is sparse, and it appears to have been absorbed by Kediri in the early twelfth century, after which eastern Java was ruled in turn by Kediri, Singhasari and Majapahit.

economy.zh: 经济以布兰塔斯河流域的稻作农业与河口港口贸易为基础，香料、稻米与林产品经此运往群岛其他地区与更远的市场，河流航运连接内陆产区与海岸。
economy.en: The economy rested on rice farming in the Brantas valley and on trade through its estuarine port, with spices, rice and forest products shipped from there to other parts of the archipelago and to more distant markets, and river navigation linking the interior producing areas with the coast.

culture.zh: 戎牙路与谏义里共享东爪哇的印度教-佛教文化，寺庙建筑与古爪哇语文学在这一时期发展，宫廷赞助的史诗与碑铭记录了王统与水利工程。
culture.en: Janggala and Kediri shared the Hindu-Buddhist culture of eastern Java, temple building and Old Javanese literature developed in this period, and epics and inscriptions patronised by the courts recorded royal lines and irrigation works. Its temples still stand in the rice fields of the delta.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1045年爱尔朗加分割国土、11世纪戎牙路的独立统治、约12世纪初被谏义里合并，以及此后东爪哇诸王国的相继兴起。
events.en: Key moments are the division of the realm by Airlangga in 1045, the separate rule of Janggala in the eleventh century, its absorption by Kediri in the early twelfth century and the rise of the later kingdoms of eastern Java that followed it.

value.zh: 1045年爱尔朗加让位后与谏义里同时形成。
value.en: It was formed in 1045 alongside Kediri when Airlangga abdicated.

value.zh: 约12世纪初被谏义里合并。
value.en: It was absorbed by Kediri in the early twelfth century.

en: New Hebrides as the colonial name for the island group in the South Pacific now known as Vanuatu, named after the Hebrides by Captain James Cook in 1774
Its administration as an Anglo-French condominium
zh: 新赫布里底群岛是南太平洋今瓦努阿图群岛的殖民时期名称，1774年由库克船长以苏格兰赫布里底群岛命名

politics.zh: 新赫布里底群岛是南太平洋今瓦努阿图群岛的殖民时期名称，1774年由库克船长以苏格兰赫布里底群岛命名，19世纪末起由英法两国以共管形式统治，设有两套行政、司法与警务体系。共管体制造成土地与劳工问题长期争议，1980年群岛独立为瓦努阿图，共管时期结束。
politics.en: New Hebrides, named after the Hebrides in Scotland by Captain James Cook in 1774, was the colonial name for the island group in the South Pacific Ocean that is now Vanuatu, and from the late nineteenth century it was governed by Britain and France as a condominium with two separate administrations, legal systems and police forces. The arrangement left land and labour questions in dispute for decades, and in 1980 the islands became independent as Vanuatu, ending the condominium.

economy.zh: 经济以椰子种植、渔业与劳工输出为基础，19世纪大量岛民被招募到斐济、昆士兰与萨摩亚的种植园做工，椰干与可可成为主要出口品，土地归属争议贯穿殖民时期。
economy.en: The economy rested on coconut planting, fishing and the export of labour, with large numbers of islanders recruited in the nineteenth century to work on plantations in Fiji, Queensland and Samoa, copra and cocoa becoming the main exports, and land ownership remaining in dispute throughout the colonial period.

culture.zh: 群岛居民使用一百多种语言，以美拉尼西亚文化传统为基础，猪牙与席垫具有交换与地位意义，基督教传教在19世纪后广泛传播，同时保留地方仪式与等级制度。
culture.en: The islanders speak more than a hundred languages and their culture is Melanesian, with pig tusks and mats carrying exchange and status value, Christian missions spreading widely after the nineteenth century while local ritual and graded societies were retained.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1774年库克命名、19世纪劳工招募与传教、1906年英法共管体制确立，以及1980年独立为瓦努阿图。
events.en: Key moments are Cook's naming of the group in 1774, the labour recruiting and missions of the nineteenth century, the establishment of the Anglo-French condominium in 1906 and independence as Vanuatu in 1980. Its memory survives in the bilingual institutions of the new state.

value.zh: 1774年由库克船长以苏格兰赫布里底群岛命名。
value.en: It was named by Captain Cook in 1774 after the Hebrides in Scotland.
From the late nineteenth century it was governed as an Anglo-French condominium.

en: Timor-Leste, also known as East Timor, officially the Democratic Republic of Timor-Leste, as a country in South-East Asia
Its composition of the eastern half of the island of Timor, the exclave of Oecusse and the islands of Atauro and Jaco
zh: 东帝汶正式称东帝汶民主共和国，位于东南亚
由帝汶岛东半部、欧库西飞地以及阿陶罗与雅科两岛组成

politics.zh: 东帝汶民主共和国位于东南亚，由帝汶岛东半部、欧库西飞地以及阿陶罗与雅科两岛组成，首都为帝力。1975年单方面宣布独立后随即被印度尼西亚占领，经历长期抵抗与冲突；1999年公投选择独立，2002年正式恢复独立，此后建立议会制共和政体并逐步稳定政局。
politics.en: Timor-Leste, also known as East Timor, is a country in South-East Asia comprising the eastern half of the island of Timor, the coastal exclave of Oecusse and the islands of Atauro and Jaco, with Dili as its capital. After a unilateral declaration of independence in 1975 it was occupied by Indonesia and went through a long resistance and conflict; a referendum in 1999 chose independence and the country formally became independent in 2002, since when it has built a parliamentary republic and gradually stabilised its politics.

economy.zh: 经济以石油与天然气收入、农业与服务业为基础，海上油气收益构成国家财政的主要来源，咖啡是重要出口农产品，多数人口从事自给农业，基础设施仍在重建与扩展中。
economy.en: The economy rests on oil and gas revenue, farming and services, with offshore hydrocarbon earnings forming the main source of state finances, coffee an important agricultural export, most of the population engaged in subsistence farming, and infrastructure still being rebuilt and extended.

culture.zh: 东帝汶文化融合马来-波利尼西亚、葡萄牙与天主教传统，德顿语与葡萄牙语同为官方语言，地方语言众多，织布与木雕工艺、口传诗歌与仪式构成文化基础。
culture.en: Timorese culture combines Malay-Polynesian, Portuguese and Catholic traditions, Tetum and Portuguese are both official among many local languages, and weaving, woodcarving, oral poetry and ritual form the basis of cultural life. Its Catholic calendar structures much of the year.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1975年宣布独立与印尼占领、1999年独立公投、2002年恢复独立，以及此后的国家建设与选举。
events.en: Key moments are the declaration of independence and the Indonesian occupation in 1975, the independence referendum of 1999, the restoration of independence in 2002 and the state-building and elections that followed. It has since held several peaceful parliamentary elections.

value.en: It formally became independent again in 2002.

value.zh: 德顿语与葡萄牙语同为官方语言。
value.en: Tetum and Portuguese are both official languages.

en: Hamengkubuwono as the current ruling royal house of the Yogyakarta Sultanate in the Special Region of Yogyakarta of Indonesia
The reigning Sultan of Yogyakarta as the hereditary head of the house
zh: 哈孟古布沃诺是印度尼西亚日惹特区日惹苏丹国的现任统治王室
在位苏丹为世袭家族首领

politics.zh: 哈孟古布沃诺是印度尼西亚日惹特区日惹苏丹国的现任统治王室，在位苏丹为世袭家族首领。该家族由1755年吉扬提条约后的苏丹哈孟古布沃诺一世建立，在荷属东印度与印尼独立后均保持文化与政治影响；日惹特区以苏丹为世袭省长，是印尼唯一保留世袭地方首长的地区。
politics.en: Hamengkubuwono is the current ruling royal house of the Yogyakarta Sultanate in the Special Region of Yogyakarta of Indonesia, and the reigning Sultan of Yogyakarta is its hereditary head. The house was founded by Sultan Hamengkubuwono I after the treaty of Giyanti in 1755 and retained cultural and political influence under the Dutch East Indies and after Indonesian independence; the special region has the Sultan as its hereditary governor, the only part of Indonesia to keep a hereditary local head.

economy.zh: 王室的收入与影响依托日惹的宫殿、土地与文化旅游，日惹是爪哇重要的教育与文化城市，蜡染、银器与宫廷工艺形成地方产业，旅游与大学经济支撑城市发展。
economy.en: The house's income and influence rest on the palace, its lands and cultural tourism in Yogyakarta, which is an important centre of education and culture in Java, with batik, silverwork and court crafts forming local industries and tourism and the universities supporting the city.

culture.zh: 日惹宫廷是爪哇古典文化的中心，甘美兰音乐、皮影戏、宫廷舞蹈与蜡染工艺在此保存，爪哇历法与宫廷仪式延续，宫殿建筑群成为文化地标。
culture.en: The Yogyakarta court is a centre of classical Javanese culture, where gamelan music, shadow puppetry, court dance and batik are preserved, the Javanese calendar and court rituals continue, and the palace complex is a cultural landmark.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1755年吉扬提条约与王室建立、荷属东印度时期的自治地位、印尼独立后的特区安排，以及王室在当代的文化与政治角色。
events.en: Key moments are the treaty of Giyanti and the founding of the house in 1755, its autonomous position under the Dutch East Indies, the special region arrangement after Indonesian independence and the house's cultural and political role today.

value.zh: 由哈孟古布沃诺一世于1755年后建立。
value.en: It was founded by Hamengkubuwono I after 1755.

value.zh: 日惹特区以苏丹为世袭省长。
value.en: The special region has the Sultan as hereditary governor.

en: The Electorate of Trier as an ecclesiastical principality of the Holy Roman Empire existing from the end of the ninth to the early nineteenth century
Its archbishop as one of the prince-electors who chose the German king
zh: 特里尔选侯国是神圣罗马帝国的教会诸侯国，自9世纪末延续至19世纪初
其大主教为选帝侯之一，参与选举德意志国王

politics.zh: 特里尔选侯国是神圣罗马帝国的教会诸侯国，自9世纪末延续至19世纪初，其大主教为选帝侯之一，参与选举德意志国王。领地位于摩泽尔河流域与莱茵河中游，由大主教兼世俗诸侯治理，设有宫廷与地方行政；法国大革命战争期间被法国占领，1803年世俗化后并入其他邦国。
politics.en: The Electorate of Trier was an ecclesiastical principality of the Holy Roman Empire that existed from the end of the ninth to the early nineteenth century, and its archbishop was one of the prince-electors who chose the German king. Its lands lay along the Moselle and the middle Rhine and were governed by the archbishop as both prelate and temporal prince with a court and local administration; during the French Revolutionary wars it was occupied by France and after secularisation in 1803 it was absorbed into other states.

economy.zh: 经济以摩泽尔河与莱茵河的葡萄酒种植、河运贸易与关税为基础，科布伦茨与特里尔是行政与商业中心，葡萄园与航运为选侯国提供主要收入来源。
economy.en: The economy rested on wine growing along the Moselle and Rhine, river trade and tolls, with Koblenz and Trier as centres of administration and commerce, and vineyards and shipping supplying the electorate's main sources of income.

culture.zh: 特里尔是德国最古老的城市之一，罗马时代的建筑与中世纪教堂并存，选侯宫廷赞助建筑、音乐与天主教改革，修道院与教堂留下丰富遗产。
culture.en: Trier is one of the oldest cities in Germany, where Roman buildings stand alongside medieval churches, the electoral court patronised architecture, music and Catholic reform, and its monasteries and churches leave a rich heritage. Its manuscript collections are still kept in the city today.

events.zh: 关键节点包括9世纪末大主教取得世俗权力、中世纪获得选侯地位、1794年起被法国占领，以及1803年世俗化后并入其他邦国。
events.en: Key moments are the acquisition of temporal power by the archbishops at the end of the ninth century, the attainment of electoral status in the Middle Ages, the French occupation from 1794 and the secularisation of 1803 that transferred its lands to other states.

value.zh: 大主教为神圣罗马帝国选帝侯之一。
value.en: Its archbishop was one of the prince-electors of the Holy Roman Empire.
After secularisation in 1803 its lands passed to other states.

en: The County of Champagne as a medieval territory and feudal principality in the Kingdom of France
Its development on the rich plains between the Ile-de-France and Burgundy
zh: 香槟伯国是法兰西王国的中世纪领地与封建公国
发展于法兰西岛与勃艮第之间的富庶平原

politics.zh: 香槟伯国是法兰西王国的中世纪领地与封建公国，发展于法兰西岛与勃艮第之间的富庶平原，以特鲁瓦为中心。伯爵通过控制香槟集市与通往佛兰德、德意志和意大利的商路积累财富，12至13世纪在宫廷中发展出骑士文学与行政文书；1284年并入法国王室领地，此后成为王太子（dauphin）的封号来源之一。
politics.en: The County of Champagne was a medieval territory and feudal principality in the Kingdom of France, developing on the rich plains between the Ile-de-France and Burgundy with Troyes as its centre. Its counts accumulated wealth by controlling the fairs of Champagne and the routes towards Flanders, Germany and Italy, and in the twelfth and thirteenth centuries their court produced chivalric literature and administrative records; in 1284 the county passed to the French crown and later gave its name to a title of the heir to the throne.

economy.zh: 经济以香槟集市、羊毛与布匹贸易及农业为基础，特鲁瓦、普罗万等城镇轮流举办年度集市，意大利与佛兰德商人汇聚于此，汇票与信用工具在交易中广泛使用。
economy.en: The economy rested on the fairs of Champagne, the wool and cloth trade and farming, with towns such as Troyes and Provins holding annual fairs in turn, merchants from Italy and Flanders gathering there, and bills of exchange and credit instruments widely used in their dealings.

culture.zh: 香槟伯爵宫廷是12至13世纪法语文学的赞助中心，克雷蒂安·德·特鲁瓦在此创作骑士传奇，宫廷礼仪与纹章文化影响后世，教堂与修道院建筑留下遗产。
culture.en: The court of the counts of Champagne patronised French literature in the twelfth and thirteenth centuries, where Chretien de Troyes wrote his romances, and its courtly manners and heraldic culture influenced later generations, while its churches and monasteries leave an architectural heritage.

events.zh: 关键节点包括11世纪伯国的形成、12至13世纪香槟集市的鼎盛、1284年并入法国王室领地，以及此后作为王位继承人称号的使用。
events.en: Key moments are the formation of the county in the eleventh century, the height of the fairs in the twelfth and thirteenth, its passage to the French crown in 1284 and its later use as a title of the heir to the throne.

value.zh: 以特鲁瓦、普罗万等地的香槟集市闻名。
value.en: It was known for the fairs of Champagne at Troyes and Provins.
It passed to the French crown in 1284.

en: Osroene, also spelled Osrhoene, as an ancient kingdom and region in Upper Mesopotamia
The Kingdom of Osroene, also known as the Kingdom of Edessa, with Edessa as its centre
Its position between the Roman and Parthian empires
zh: 奥斯若恩是上美索不达米亚的古代王国与地区
又称埃德萨王国，以埃德萨为中心
位于罗马与帕提亚两大帝国之间

politics.zh: 奥斯若恩又称埃德萨王国，是上美索不达米亚的古代王国与地区，以埃德萨（今土耳其乌尔法）为中心，位于罗马与帕提亚两大帝国之间。它由本地阿拉伯-阿拉米王统统治，长期在两大帝国之间周旋，公元2世纪后成为罗马的附庸，212年前后被并入罗马帝国，改为行省。
politics.en: Osroene, also spelled Osrhoene, was an ancient kingdom and region in Upper Mesopotamia, known as the Kingdom of Edessa and centred on Edessa, modern Urfa in Turkey, lying between the Roman and Parthian empires. Ruled by a local Arab-Aramaic royal line, it manoeuvred for centuries between the two empires, became a Roman client after the second century AD and was incorporated into the Roman empire as a province around 212.

economy.zh: 经济以两河北部平原的农业、商队贸易与手工业为基础，埃德萨处在连接安纳托利亚、叙利亚与美索不达米亚的商路上，过境贸易与税收为王国提供收入。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming in the northern Mesopotamian plain, caravan trade and crafts, with Edessa on the routes linking Anatolia, Syria and Mesopotamia, and transit trade and taxation supplying the kingdom's revenue. Its markets also served the villages of the surrounding plain.

culture.zh: 奥斯若恩是叙利亚语基督教的重要发源地，埃德萨的学校与抄写传统影响深远，叙利亚语文献在此形成，本地异教与基督教、犹太教传统长期并存。
culture.en: Osroene was an important birthplace of Syriac Christianity, the schools and scribal tradition of Edessa were widely influential, Syriac literature took shape there, and local pagan, Christian and Jewish traditions long coexisted. Its chronicles are a main source for early Syriac history.

events.zh: 关键节点包括公元前2世纪前后王国形成、长期在罗马与帕提亚之间周旋、2世纪成为罗马附庸，以及约212年被并入罗马帝国。
events.en: Key moments are the formation of the kingdom around the second century BC, its long manoeuvring between Rome and Parthia, its becoming a Roman client in the second century AD and its incorporation into the Roman empire around 212.

value.zh: 以埃德萨（今土耳其乌尔法）为中心。
value.en: It was centred on Edessa, modern Urfa in Turkey.
It was incorporated into the Roman empire around 212.

en: Italy, officially the Italian Republic, as a country in Southern and Western Europe
Its peninsula extending into the Mediterranean with the Alps on its northern land border
zh: 意大利正式称意大利共和国，位于南欧与西欧
半岛延伸入地中海，北部陆地边界为阿尔卑斯山

politics.zh: 意大利共和国位于南欧与西欧，半岛延伸入地中海，北部陆地边界为阿尔卑斯山，首都为罗马。1861年意大利王国成立，1946年公投废除君主制建立共和国；二战后的共和国实行议会制，地区分权与南北差异是其政治与经济生活的长期特征，1957年为基础条约签署国之一。
politics.en: Italy, officially the Italian Republic, is a country in Southern and Western Europe whose peninsula extends into the Mediterranean Sea, with the Alps on its northern land border and Rome as its capital. The Kingdom of Italy was proclaimed in 1861 and a referendum in 1946 abolished the monarchy and created the republic; the post-war republic is parliamentary, regional autonomy and the north-south divide are long-standing features of its politics and economy, and it was one of the signatories of the founding treaties of 1957.

economy.zh: 经济以制造业、服务业、农业与旅游业为基础，机械、汽车、时尚与食品加工是重要产业，中小企业网络构成工业体系特色，南北地区发展差距明显。
economy.en: The economy rests on manufacturing, services, agriculture and tourism, with machinery, vehicles, fashion and food processing among the leading industries, a network of small and medium firms shaping the industrial system, and a marked development gap between north and south.

culture.zh: 意大利文化以罗马遗产、文艺复兴艺术与地方传统为基础，罗马、佛罗伦萨与威尼斯等地留下大量世界遗产，歌剧、文学与电影影响深远，各地饮食与方言构成丰富的地方认同。
culture.en: Italian culture rests on Roman heritage, Renaissance art and local tradition, with Rome, Florence and Venice among the many World Heritage sites, opera, literature and cinema widely influential, and regional cuisines and dialects forming rich local identities.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1861年王国成立、1946年废除君主制建立共和国、1957年参与创建欧洲共同体，以及此后的欧洲一体化进程。
events.en: Key moments are the proclamation of the kingdom in 1861, the abolition of the monarchy and creation of the republic in 1946, its part in founding the European Communities in 1957 and the European integration that followed.

value.zh: 1946年公投废除君主制，建立共和国。
value.en: A referendum in 1946 abolished the monarchy and created the republic.
